name: Floating Panel (Gattuccino)
description: Companion to the Gattuccino shell theme. Lets the top bar float as a rounded bar, and docks it back to a normal full-width bar while a window is maximized or close to it. The look itself comes from the theme: with another theme this extension changes nothing. The gap around the floating bar and how round it is are settings of the extension, changed while it runs.
